lessons.claim: De-duplication in a content-addressed repo must be proven numerically inert, not argued. Rewriting bias_from_dt from 50*r to 100*(r/2) is the same real number but not obviously the same float; a 200k-draw probe found zero disagreements, and only then was it safe. Two errors were caught this way that reading would not have found: (1) a first pass compared the rewritten function against a hand-typed literal instead of the old formula on the same pint-derived ratio, producing a false failure; (2) the docstring claimed the linearized/exact dt gap equals b/(1+b) when it is exactly b -- off by b^2, invisible in any output. Pair every merge with a checker AND deliberately re-fork the merge to confirm the checker fires.
